user.title: Entity ID Manager
user.description: Configure independent ID segments. Open integration options after setup.

value.title: ID segment
value.description: Object: {object}. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, underscores; start with a letter. Leave empty to remove the override. Open preview to apply.

preview.title: Select renames
preview.description:

{conflicts}

automatic.title: New entities
automatic.description: Rename newly registered entities using saved rules. Existing entities are not renamed; references to newly renamed entities are updated.

editor.title: Mapping editor
editor.description: [Open editor](/entity-id-manager). Edit multiple objects and confirm all mappings together. Return to Preview and apply to rename entities.

error.invalid_segment: Use lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscores; start with a letter.
error.stale_preview: Apply did not complete. Check logs and the refreshed preview; select changes again.
